cohort: 315 mothers (105 with low birth weight infants and 210 controls)
finding: Educational and occupational status, mode of delivery, gestational age, maternal weight, and history of low birth weight were independent predictors of low birth weight.
mod_finding: Vaginal mode of delivery was associated with lower odds of low birth weight (AOR 0.45, 95% CI 0.25-0.82).
